# Giveaways sub-actions

## Close, draw or cancel giveaway

Controls the running giveaway: stop taking entries, draw winners, draw one more winner, or cancel it and give points back.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Do** | Close entries = nobody else can join. Draw winners = pick the winners. Draw one more = pick another winner. Cancel and refund = stop and give ticket points back. Options: Close entries, Draw winners, Draw one more, Cancel and refund. Starts as: `Draw winners`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if there was a giveaway to act on |
| `%winner%` | The latest winner's name |
| `%winners%` | All winners so far, separated by commas |
| `%entrants%` | How many viewers joined |

<small>Type id: `giveaways.control`</small>

## Open giveaway

Opens a giveaway where viewers join by typing a chat command. Later, draw the winners with "Close, draw or cancel giveaway".

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Prize** | The prize, like "Steam game key". |
| **Join command** | The chat command viewers type to join, like !join. Starts as: `!join`. |
| **Points per ticket (0: free)** | How many points one ticket costs. 0 = joining is free. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Most tickets per viewer** | The most tickets one viewer may have. Viewers buy more by typing !join 3. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Points currency** | The name of the points tickets cost, like "Coins". Empty = your normal points. |
| **Subscriber luck** | How much better subscribers' tickets count. 2 = each subscriber ticket counts double. 1 = same as everyone. Starts as: `1`. |
| **Subscribers only** | Tick so only subscribers can join. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Seconds taking entries (0: until closed)** | How many seconds entries are taken, then it closes by itself. 0 = until you close it. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Winners** | How many winners to draw. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%giveawayId%` | The giveaway's internal id |

<small>Type id: `giveaways.open`</small>
